scanner: Fusion EU Automated Static Security & Hardening Auditor

findings.finding: Scanned for plaintext database or admin passwords. All seeds use bcrypt hashes; production passwords must be supplied via runtime environment variables.
Zero private keys or wallet seeds committed. Only public receiving address variables are recognized.
Checkout fallbacks removed. System requires explicit runtime BANK_IBAN and BANK_BIC_SWIFT from verified business credentials.
Default test fallback uses explicit unspendable placeholder string (bc1q_placeholder_btc_test_only). Real cold-storage wallet addresses must be injected via CRYPTO_BTC_ADDRESS.
Public tracking APIs, third-party tracking links, and internal hub logistics notes are strictly omitted from public order status responses.
All customer order and address actions strictly derive identity from the verified cryptographic HMAC session cookie. Unauthorized cross-customer requests return 403 Forbidden.
Role transition matrix prevents customers from advancing orders to PAYMENT_VERIFIED or SHIPPED. Only authorized administrative roles can advance verified states.
Client-submitted unit prices, discounts, and shipping amounts are discarded. Server authoritative recalculation against catalog database minor units is enforced.
MIME type whitelist, executable extension defense, double extension rejection, path traversal protection, size caps (5MB), and unguessable private storage keys enforced.
Distributed sliding-window rate limiting configured across login, registration, password reset, guest lookup, payment proof submission, and order creation.
Public payment configuration endpoints return rail types only; bank account numbers, IBANs, and crypto addresses are hidden until individual order initialization.
Automated recursive scrubbing redacts passwords, tokens, IBANs, and private keys prior to structured logging or audit persistence.
Deprecated statuses PAYMENT_CONFIRMED and DISPATCHED are completely purged from runtime code and state transition graphs.
HSTS (max-age 63072000; includeSubDomains; preload), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy, and CSP configured.

findings.category: Search Engine Indexing of Private Routes
findings.finding: Robots.txt disallows and HTTP response headers inject X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow, noarchive on /admin, /account, /cart, /checkout, /orders, and /api.
Prisma client singleton persists across serverless warm invocations; pooled connection string (PgBouncer) configured for runtime.
Neutral sender identities, no tracking claims without configured tracking numbers, discreet packaging descriptions verified.
Consent logging, Article 15 JSON data export, Article 17 account erasure with fiscal anonymization, and non-essential cookie gating implemented.
